item.title: ANT-MAN Star Evangeline Lilly Reveals Concerning Health Update Following Accident: "I Do Have Brain Damage"
item.description: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania star Evangeline Lilly, who plays Hope Van Dyne in the MCU, has revealed a concerning health update following her recent accident...

item.title: RUMOR: Marvel Studios Is Moving Forward With THE FANTASTIC FOUR 2 (And We Know Who They Want To Direct It)
item.description: According to a new report, Marvel Studios is moving forward with a sequel to The Fantastic Four: First Steps for the post-Avengers: Secret Wars MCU, and they already have a director in mind.

item.title: DC Studios Co-CEO James Gunn "[Hoping] And [Praying] For The Best" With Netflix Deal; Shares SUPERGIRL Update
item.description: Man of Tomorrow director James Gunn has talked more about Netflix's planned acquisition of Warner Bros., and confirms that Supergirl isn't a direct adaptation of the Woman of Tomorrow comic.

item.title: SHANG-CHI Star Simu Liu Endorses Melissa Barrera For DCU's Wonder Woman: "She's A Total Badass"
item.description: The DCU's Wonder Woman is expected to debut in Man of Tomorrow before starring in an Ana Nogueira-penned solo movie, but is Melissa Barrera (Scream) a good fit for Diana Prince? Simu Liu thinks so.

item.title: RUMOR: WONDER MAN May Not Reveal Where Simon Williams' Powers Came From - Possible SPOILERS
item.description: According to a new rumour, the upcoming Wonder Man series isn't expected to take a deep dive into where Simon Williams' powers came from, glossing over his convoluted history in the comics.

item.title: RUMOR: DEADPOOL & WOLVERINE Star Returning To MCU As One Of SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY's Villains
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day reportedly features several minor comic book villains, and a new rumour reveals that a Deadpool & Wolverine star will be playing one of Spidey's sinister foes.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumored To Feature The Big-Screen Debut Of This Fan-Favorite Disney+ Character - SPOILERS
item.description: According to a new rumor, a certain character that made their debut in one of the most popular Disney+ MCU shows will make the jump to the big screen for Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: IRON MAN 2 Star Mickey Rourke Launches GoFundMe To Prevent Eviction And Cover $60,000 Of Unpaid Rent
item.description: Iron Man 2 and Sin City star Mickey Rourke has launched a GoFundMe that aims to pay nearly $60,000 in unpaid rent, thereby preventing him from being evicted from his Los Angeles home.

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Officially Passes $1 Billion Worldwide After Less Than 3 Weeks In Theaters
item.description: As it approaches its third week in theaters, James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash has grossed $777M internationally and $306M domestically for a total of $1.08 billion worldwide...

item.title: POWER RANGERS: Some Of The Actors Being Eyed For Disney+'s Upcoming Reboot Reportedly Revealed
item.description: As Disney+'s Power Rangers reboot starts taking shape at the streamer, we have an early look at some of the young actors reportedly being eyed for lead roles in the series.
